objective: Review the two merge commits that stack the Pi wiring branches (28d2b56 on release/0.3.0/feat/pi-tool-settings and eb12e30 on release/0.3.0/feat/pi-review-prompts) for merge mistakes.
scope: 28d2b56 merges release/0.3.0/feat/pi-root-wiring (e2b516b) into pi-tool-settings; eb12e30 merges pi-tool-settings into pi-review-prompts. Worktrees /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-settings and /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-prompts. Both merged without conflicts.

Check with git show --cc and git diff of each parent against the merge that no change from either side was lost or duplicated, especially in files both sides touched (docs/pi/extensions.md, docs/pi/README.md, docs/pi/configuration.md, docs/usage.md, the generated dist bundles); that statements in those docs still agree with the merged code; and that the generated dist matches the merged sources (a fresh build left both trees clean and verify passed: 2334 and 2352 pass).
constraints: Read-only; no edits and no version-control writes.

criteria.text: Each merge keeps every change of both parents, and the merged docs agree with the merged code
